notes: Even though it refers to a person, παιδί is a neuter noun, so it takes neuter articles and adjectives (e.g., το καλό παιδί).
In the plural (παιδιά), it is also very commonly used among friends or young people to mean 'guys' or 'folks' (e.g., Γεια σας, παιδιά!).
